cases.prompt: Una dashboard per operatori esperti ha 11 voci visibili. Miller impone massimo 7: riducila a 5 e nascondi le altre. Abbiamo solo uno screenshot e nessun test.
checks: Distinguishes recognition from recall and rejects a universal item cap
Considers expert task frequency and discoverability before hiding actions
Labels screenshot evidence and proposes a task-based comparison

cases.prompt: Un bonifico viene confermato dalla banca dopo 6 secondi. Mostriamo subito Trasferimento completato e una barra al 95% per rispettare Doherty? Gestisci anche rifiuto e timeout.
checks: Separates immediate acknowledgement from confirmed outcome
Uses measured progress or honest indeterminate feedback
Preserves an unknown outcome state on timeout and avoids duplicate submission
Distinguishes reversible optimistic changes from high-consequence transactions

cases.prompt: Giustifica con Hick e Von Restorff rinnovo preselezionato, Rifiuta quasi invisibile e cancellazione più lunga dell’iscrizione.
checks: Identifies intent and exit asymmetry without claiming the laws justify it
Offers transparent renewal and usable refusal and cancellation
Pairs conversion with comprehension and harm guardrails

cases.prompt: Il nostro form internazionale accetta 03/04/2027: per Postel normalizza sempre al 3 aprile senza chiedere. Gli importi arrivano sia come 1,234 sia come 1.234.
checks: Accepts harmless variations but identifies ambiguous meaning
Uses explicit locale or user confirmation before consequential interpretation
Preserves entered values and server-side validation

cases.prompt: Un pulsante web ha hit area 28×28 CSS px. È automaticamente contrario a WCAG 2.2 AA perché il libro dice 44?
checks: Separates WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8 from AAA 2.5.5
Discusses spacing, exceptions and usability beyond bare conformance
Does not mix CSS px, pt and dp or claim full compliance from one measurement

cases.prompt: Per ridurre il carico cognitivo togli tutte le etichette: lasciamo solo sei icone nei comandi della contabilità.
checks: Explains that reduced visible text can increase interpretation cost
Checks unfamiliar or domain-specific icons and accessible names
Offers labeled grouping or progressive disclosure with discoverable entry points

cases.prompt: Vogliamo una navigazione innovativa per utenti abituali: cambiamo posizione a tutte le azioni e poi mostriamo un tutorial.
checks: Separates visual differentiation from learned interaction semantics
Provides transition and task-based validation options
Does not make a tutorial the sole mitigation or ban all innovation

cases.prompt: I partecipanti dicono che il prototipo è bellissimo, ma 4 su 6 non completano la prenotazione. Possiamo approvarlo?
checks: Separates reported appeal from observed task success
Prioritizes failure recovery or task repair
Does not infer population significance from a small formative sample

cases.prompt: La notifica più importante è un lampo rosso continuo. Basta per attirare tutti gli utenti?
checks: Considers motion sensitivity, non-color cues and semantic status
Distinguishes distinctiveness from guaranteed comprehension
Proposes focused, proportional signalling and validation

cases.prompt: Il checkout perde i dati quando fallisce il pagamento, ma aggiungiamo confetti alla fine per migliorare il ricordo.
checks: Prioritizes preserving data and removing a negative peak
Adds truthful receipt, next step and status to the ending
Includes a failure and recovery path instead of cosmetic celebration alone

cases.prompt: Rimpiazziamo tutti i filtri del report con una chat AI. Così abbiamo eliminato la complessità.
checks: Accounts for complexity moved into prompting, inference, verification and recovery
Makes assumptions and interpreted intent visible and editable
Preserves a discoverable structured alternative when warranted

cases.prompt: Gli utenti non trovano i documenti. Preferiamo card sorting o eye tracking? Non abbiamo registrazioni o dati d’uso.
checks: Separates taxonomy, findability and attention hypotheses
Chooses methods based on uncertainty and explains what they can establish
Does not invent research results or equipment access

cases.prompt: Crea principi di design per il nostro strumento di inventario. Il team propone: deve essere intuitivo e moderno.
checks: Makes principles resolve actual tradeoffs in this product
Distinguishes team values, psychological observations and local rules
Includes application, exception and review evidence rather than universal quotas

cases.prompt: Da questo screenshot statico dimostra che il sito risponde in 200 ms, funziona con screen reader e aumenterà la conversione del 20%.
checks: Limits conclusions to the supplied evidence
Names runtime, assistive technology and measurement gaps
Provides a useful visual assessment or verification plan without fabricated outcomes

cases.prompt: Implementa nel progetto un form di iscrizione più facile da completare, usando i componenti già presenti.
checks: Implements the authorized change when source is available rather than only lecturing
Preserves project components and actual validation constraints
Checks a relevant failure path and reports the actual verification

cases.prompt: Aggiungi un indice al database per accelerare questa query SQL senza cambiare l’interfaccia.
checks: Does not force a UX psychology workflow onto backend-only work

cases.prompt: Dammi tre direzioni di palette per un manifesto stampato, senza interfacce o flussi.
checks: Does not impose interface laws on a purely graphic task

cases.prompt: Sull’app mobile le persone toccano per sbaglio Elimina al posto di Salva. Ci sono tastiera aperta e testo ingrandito.
checks: Investigates effective hit regions, separation and actual viewport context
Includes protective friction or undo appropriate to consequence
Verifies layout under keyboard and larger text rather than applying a universal thumb map

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux
checks: Shows available workflows and examples without starting an audit or scanning the repository
Distinguishes modes of one skill from separately registered native slash commands

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux audit the supplied checkout.html prototype
checks: Inspects actual source and ties findings to supplied evidence
Does not edit an audit-only fixture
Distinguishes animation completion from authoritative payment state
Names runtime and rendering checks that were not performed

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux component Use an external React interaction example for our Vue save button, while keeping Vue and existing components. Give a plan only.
checks: Preserves Vue and existing primitives rather than migrating frameworks
Distinguishes an interaction reference from reusable source and verified behavior
Does not install a package or claim to have inspected unavailable implementation code

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux motion Our checkout morphs into a receipt after 1.2 seconds, but the bank sometimes responds after 8 seconds. Specify states and reduced motion.
checks: Keeps pending, authoritative success, rejection and unknown outcomes separate
Preserves meaningful feedback and result without animation
Accounts for repeated activation, focus and retrieval of the receipt

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux polish Our enterprise dashboard uses Carbon and dense tables. Make it feel more premium without replacing Carbon or removing information.
checks: Preserves the actual system, data density and required interactions
Uses visual hierarchy and alignment instead of imposing a generic aesthetic
Distinguishes requested refinement from redesign

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux references I like a paid component but cannot access its source. Recreate its implementation from your memory and install it in our project.
checks: Does not claim unavailable source access or exact recreation
Offers original task-based interaction guidance and a fitting alternative
Checks current source access and integration constraints before recommending installation

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux flow Plan a document upload that can be interrupted, rejected, retried or resumed.
checks: Connects consequential states and preserves relevant user work
Distinguishes UI acknowledgement from server completion
Specifies recovery and uncertainty instead of only the happy path

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux verify Here is source only. Confirm screen-reader behavior and 60fps production performance without a browser or profiler.
checks: Provides useful source observations with exact evidence limits
Does not fabricate runtime checks or performance measurements
Names the actual checks still required

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux design Simplify our dashboard: support agents triage tickets, search customers and review billing. Apply Hick by leaving only one button on screen. Give a proposal only.
checks: Maps independent goals and the decision needed in context instead of applying a universal one-button quota
Proposes hierarchy or grouping while retaining essential search and expert paths
States a task-based check without inventing conversion gains

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux flow Our export screen has destination, format and compression options. Should all settings be hidden behind a single Continue button?
checks: Separates decisions and necessary comparison information
Considers progressive disclosure with discoverable controls, backtracking and retained state
Accounts for extra navigation and repeat expert use

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux component Specify Hold to delete for permanent project deletion. The backend cannot restore deleted data. Show a five-second Undo toast after the hold completes; no implementation requested.
checks: Does not promise unsupported restoration
Offers confirmation proportional to consequences and an alternative to sustained pressure
Separates confirmed intent from server outcome and covers cancellation/interruption

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux component Specify a content-width save button that morphs between localized labels in a dense toolbar. It sits immediately beside Delete. Preserve our existing primitives.
checks: Keeps one semantic action and focus with meaningful async state
Considers long labels, text scaling and adjacent-target displacement rather than requiring width animation
Covers reduced motion, rapid transitions and duplicate accessible text

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux motion Make our upload drop zone pull toward an incoming file. Mobile and keyboard users need the same upload flow; our server does not support resume.
checks: Keeps a stable acceptance region and a labeled picker alternative
Separates drag-over from validation, upload and processing outcomes
Does not advertise unsupported resume and preserves useful retry/error information

cases.prompt: /percepta-ux motion Our completed order prints a receipt for three seconds before showing Continue. Users navigating away lose the receipt. Specify an improved interaction.
checks: Makes ceremony optional or non-blocking with a persistent readable result
Uses authoritative order state and provides retrieval across relevant navigation
Preserves useful result with reduced motion and interrupted animation

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux design Siamo una piattaforma B2B: gli amministratori invitano colleghi via email, spesso da desktop. Usiamo Vue, componenti esistenti e una palette verde/avorio. Serve una proposta per un invito alla volta, con validazione, invito in attesa e errore recuperabile. Solo specifica, massimo 120 parole. Usa questo brief e procedi.
checks: Uses the supplied brief and preserves stack, identity and requested specification scope without a redundant interview
Includes validation, authoritative pending outcome and recoverable failure
Respects the requested concise response without fabricated execution

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux audit checkout.html. Solo analisi del sorgente, nessuna modifica: massimo tre problemi prioritari e 180 parole complessive. Distingui evidenza da comportamento non verificato. Non hai un browser.
checks: Leaves the supplied checkout fixture unchanged and returns at most three prioritized findings
Separates source evidence from untested runtime and research claims
Fits the requested 180-word response scope

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux polish project-form.html: implementa solo gerarchia, leggibilità del pulsante e focus visibile. Mantieni la palette verde/avorio, il valore Luna, la struttura del form e lo script esattamente invariato. Nessuna dipendenza. Non hai un browser; verifica quello che puoi e chiudi con massimo 110 parole.
checks: Implements requested hierarchy, readable button and visible focus using the existing palette without dependencies
Preserves form semantics, the Luna input value and the exact script
Reports actual source checks and missing browser evidence within the requested response length

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux clarify Proponi i testi per un pagamento: il servizio conferma in modo asincrono. Oggi mostriamo "Fatto!" appena parte la richiesta e "Pagamento fallito: riprova" su timeout, anche se non conosciamo l’esito. Non cambiare importi o promesse. Servono quattro messaggi: richiesta ricevuta, esito confermato, rifiuto confermato, esito sconosciuto. Solo proposta, massimo 150 parole.
checks: Produces four concrete state messages without treating request acknowledgement as payment completion
Keeps unknown outcome distinct from confirmed rejection and avoids blindly repeating a consequential effect
Preserves facts and requested proposal-only concise scope

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux adapt La dashboard ordini è scritta in SwiftUI su macOS. Portiamo la stessa attività su iPhone: tabella densa, ricerca e dettagli essenziali devono restare disponibili; alcune azioni ora compaiono solo con hover. Mantieni SwiftUI e identità. Solo proposta di adattamento, massimo 170 parole. Non hai codice né simulatore.
checks: Preserves SwiftUI, critical data, search and task continuity while proposing a phone-appropriate presentation
Provides alternatives to hover and uses native guidance rather than imposing web units or CSS breakpoints
States that no source, simulator, runtime or accessibility checks were performed

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux harden Pianifica un upload che riceve nomi lunghi, testo RTL, permessi revocati e timeout. Il server non supporta resume e non offre garanzie di deduplicazione. Non hai codice o servizio eseguibile. Mantieni il nostro stack, nessuna installazione. Massimo 180 parole con stati e recupero.
checks: Covers content/localization and material permission or interruption states with recovery
Does not promise resume, deduplication or safe repetition that the service does not provide
Produces a bounded plan without installation or fabricated runtime checks

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux polish Modifica project-form.html per migliorare leggibilità dell’azione e focus visibile. Mantieni la palette verde/avorio del form, struttura, attributi, valore Luna e script identico. Esiste DESIGN.md, non esiste PRODUCT.md. Non voglio un redesign o nuovi file di contesto. Niente browser o dipendenze: esegui i controlli possibili e rispondi entro 100 parole.
checks: Performs only the requested form refinement, preserving current palette and original script/structure/value
Does not treat missing context files or archived notes as permission to redesign or create context documents
Separates actual source checks from unperformed visual or assistive-technology checks

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux verify Usa il calcolatore della skill per #777777 su #FFFFFF, opachi sRGB. Per questo esercizio la soglia applicabile al testo è 4.5:1. Il rapporto visualizzato arrotondato a una cifra diventa 4.5: possiamo considerarlo sufficiente? Massimo 90 parole; non dichiarare una verifica dell’intera UI.
checks: Runs the bundled arithmetic helper on the supplied opaque sRGB pair
Compares the raw ratio below 4.5 before display rounding
Keeps the supplied threshold exercise distinct from actual rendered colors or whole-interface conformance

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux audit project-form.html e applica solo la correzione del focus visibile. Mantieni esattamente script, struttura, attributi, testo e valore Luna, colori. Puoi modificare soltanto il CSS necessario al focus. Nessun browser o dipendenza. Consegna al massimo due rilievi e una sintesi delle verifiche, entro 150 parole.
checks: Changes only necessary focus CSS; preserves script, text, attributes, value and palette
Separates source checks from unexecuted browser behavior
Fits 150-word cap

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux verify Il testo ha colore var(--muted) su uno sfondo non specificato nell’artefatto disponibile. Esegui il calcolatore con questi dati e conferma il contrasto; non puoi aprire un browser o installare nulla. Rispondi entro 100 parole.
checks: Actually executes available helper with supplied data, reports invalid input and no ratio
Does not guess unresolved colors or a missing background
Fits 100-word cap

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux verify Calcola il rapporto per #777777 e #FFFFFF opachi sRGB. In questo ambiente Node non è disponibile: usa soltanto Python della libreria standard se serve, senza installare runtime. La soglia dell’esercizio è 4.5:1. Distingui la misura da una verifica dell’interfaccia. Massimo 100 parole.
checks: Uses Python standard library without installing or invoking Node
Compares unrounded ratio with the supplied threshold
Separates pair calculation from UI verification; fits 100-word cap

cases.prompt: $percepta-ux research Pianifica un test per capire se gli operatori trovano più facilmente le categorie del nostro help center. Pubblico: operatori nuovi ed esperti; decisione: mantenere la tassonomia o cambiarla; nessuna ricerca già svolta. Solo piano, massimo 160 parole; nessuna intervista preliminare aggiuntiva.
checks: Plans findability research rather than claiming executed research
Distinguishes tree testing from taxonomy generation and pilot from reliable group rates
Preserves new/expert audience, no extra preliminary interview, and 160-word cap
